about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Building scalable backend systems with Python and modern cloud practices
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Python Developer with 5+ years of experience in the development and analysis of Python, Django, and Odoo server technologies-based applications.

I design and develop consumer-based features using Python and Django within test-driven development (TDD) and pair-based programming environments, implementing MVC architecture and GraphQL query/mutation APIs for CRUD operations.

My experience spans church management and survey platforms, payment integrations (Fortis), SMS gateways, AWS S3 storage, CI/CD with Git, Docker containerization, and Kubernetes for microservices deployment.
I bring strong problem-solving skills with a focus on scalability, security, and maintainability — plus effective communication for leading teams or collaborating in Agile environments.

items.problem: Churches needed an all-in-one system to manage membership, events, giving, small groups, sacraments, and reporting — with mobile giving, payment processing, and automated follow-up workflows.
items.solution: Built a comprehensive church management platform with Django backend, GraphQL APIs for flexible data access, PostgreSQL for relational data, Fortis payment integration, SMS gateway configuration, and AWS S3 for storage — deployed on Kubernetes.
items.architecture: Web/Mobile Clients → GraphQL API → Django MVC → PostgreSQL → AWS S3 → Payment/SMS Integrations
challenges: Designing GraphQL schemas for complex membership and event workflows
Integrating Fortis Payment for web and mobile giving
Configuring SMS gateway for congregation communication
Building automated people flows for follow-ups and task completion
Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes
results: Delivered a full church operations platform over 3+ years
Unified membership, events, giving, and small group management
Enabled mobile, text, and online giving with accounting integration
Automated workflows for guest follow-up and task completion
Production deployment with CI/CD and cloud storage on AWS S3

Ensuring accurate data capture and validation across survey types
Monitoring real-time survey progress for field teams
Designing analytics and visualization for organizational insights
results: Delivered end-to-end survey capture and tracking over 1.5 years
Enabled organizations to monitor survey progress in real time
Provided data analytics and visualization for decision-making
Maintained accurate data management across survey workflows
